claim_revisions_claim_text_shape.name: claim_revisions_claim_text_shape
claim_revisions_claim_text_shape.value:
(
      ("claim_revisions"."state" = 'active' and "claim_revisions"."claim_text" is not null and btrim("claim_revisions"."claim_text") <> '')
      or ("claim_revisions"."state" = 'withdrawn' and "claim_revisions"."claim_text" is null)
    )

document_text_extraction_pages_failed_pl.name: document_text_extraction_pages_failed_placeholder_shape
document_text_extraction_pages_failed_pl.value:
(
      ("document_text_extraction_pages"."status" = 'succeeded' and "document_text_extraction_pages"."error_code" is null and "document_text_extraction_pages"."error_message" is null)
      or ("document_text_extraction_pages"."status" = 'failed' and "document_text_extraction_pages"."text" = '' and "document_text_extraction_pages"."character_count" = 0 and "document_text_extraction_pages"."error_code" is not null and btrim("document_text_extraction_pages"."error_code") <> '')
    )

document_text_extractions_page_count_sha.name: document_text_extractions_page_count_shape
document_text_extractions_page_count_sha.value:
(
      ("document_text_extractions"."status" in ('succeeded', 'partial') and "document_text_extractions"."page_count" is not null and "document_text_extractions"."page_count" > 0 and "document_text_extractions"."page_count" <= 2000)
      or ("document_text_extractions"."status" = 'failed' and ("document_text_extractions"."page_count" is null or ("document_text_extractions"."page_count" > 0 and "document_text_extractions"."page_count" <= 2000)))
    )

document_text_extractions_character_coun.name: document_text_extractions_character_count_shape
document_text_extractions_character_coun.value:
(
      ("document_text_extractions"."status" in ('succeeded', 'partial') and "document_text_extractions"."character_count" is not null and "document_text_extractions"."character_count" >= 0 and "document_text_extractions"."character_count" <= 10000000)
      or ("document_text_extractions"."status" = 'failed' and "document_text_extractions"."character_count" is null)
    )

document_text_extractions_times_ordered.name: document_text_extractions_times_ordered
document_text_extractions_times_ordered.value: "document_text_extractions"."completed_at" is null or "document_text_extractions"."started_at" is null or "document_text_extractions"."completed_at" >= "document_text_extractions"."started_at"

evidence_extraction_offset_nonnegative.name: evidence_extraction_offset_nonnegative
evidence_extraction_offset_nonnegative.value:
(
      ("evidence"."extraction_start_offset" is null and "evidence"."extraction_end_offset" is null)
      or ("evidence"."extraction_start_offset" is not null and "evidence"."extraction_end_offset" is not null and "evidence"."extraction_start_offset" >= 0 and "evidence"."extraction_end_offset" > "evidence"."extraction_start_offset")
    )

extraction_value_revisions_value_shape.name: extraction_value_revisions_value_shape
extraction_value_revisions_value_shape.value:
(
      ("extraction_value_revisions"."value_state" <> 'present' and "extraction_value_revisions"."text_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."number_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."boolean_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."option_id" is null)
      or ("extraction_value_revisions"."value_state" = 'present' and (
        ("extraction_value_revisions"."field_type" in ('short_text', 'long_text') and "extraction_value_revisions"."text_value" is not null and "extraction_value_revisions"."number_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."boolean_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."option_id" is null)
        or ("extraction_value_revisions"."field_type" = 'number' and "extraction_value_revisions"."text_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."number_value" is not null and "extraction_value_revisions"."boolean_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."option_id" is null)
        or ("extraction_value_revisions"."field_type" = 'boolean' and "extraction_value_revisions"."text_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."number_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."boolean_value" is not null and "extraction_value_revisions"."option_id" is null)
        or ("extraction_value_revisions"."field_type" = 'single_select' and "extraction_value_revisions"."text_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."number_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."boolean_value" is null and "extraction_value_revisions"."option_id" is not null)
      ))
    )

full_text_screening_decisions_exclusion_.name: full_text_screening_decisions_exclusion_shape
full_text_screening_decisions_exclusion_.value:
(
      ("full_text_screening_decisions"."decision" = 'exclude' and "full_text_screening_decisions"."exclusion_criterion_id" is not null)
      or ("full_text_screening_decisions"."decision" in ('include', 'maybe') and "full_text_screening_decisions"."exclusion_criterion_id" is null)
    )

manuscript_claim_placement_events_shape_.name: manuscript_claim_placement_events_shape_valid
manuscript_claim_placement_events_shape_.value:
(
      ("manuscript_claim_placement_events"."event_type" = 'placed' and "manuscript_claim_placement_events"."from_claim_revision_id" is null and "manuscript_claim_placement_events"."to_claim_revision_id" is not null)
      or ("manuscript_claim_placement_events"."event_type" = 'replaced' and "manuscript_claim_placement_events"."from_claim_revision_id" is not null and "manuscript_claim_placement_events"."to_claim_revision_id" is not null and "manuscript_claim_placement_events"."from_claim_revision_id" <> "manuscript_claim_placement_events"."to_claim_revision_id")
      or ("manuscript_claim_placement_events"."event_type" = 'removed' and "manuscript_claim_placement_events"."from_claim_revision_id" is not null and "manuscript_claim_placement_events"."to_claim_revision_id" is null)
    )

screening_decisions_exclusion_shape.name: screening_decisions_exclusion_shape
screening_decisions_exclusion_shape.value:
(
      ("screening_decisions"."decision" = 'exclude' and "screening_decisions"."exclusion_criterion_id" is not null and "screening_decisions"."exclusion_criterion_type" = 'exclusion')
      or ("screening_decisions"."decision" in ('include', 'maybe') and "screening_decisions"."exclusion_criterion_id" is null and "screening_decisions"."exclusion_criterion_type" is null)
    )

synthesis_revisions_statement_shape.name: synthesis_revisions_statement_shape
synthesis_revisions_statement_shape.value:
(
      ("synthesis_revisions"."state" = 'active' and "synthesis_revisions"."statement_text" is not null and btrim("synthesis_revisions"."statement_text") <> '')
      or ("synthesis_revisions"."state" = 'withdrawn' and "synthesis_revisions"."statement_text" is null)
    )
